newsitem.title: USA: Foamex completes debt tender offers.
newsitem.headline: Foamex completes debt tender offers.

text.p: Foamex International said Friday that it has completed tender offers, totaling about $459 million in aggregate principal, to repurchase outstanding public debt.
In addition, all of the outstanding $116.7 million principal amount of the Foamex-JPS Automotive LP Senior Secured Discount Debentures due 2004 were also tendered and accepted in the tender offer.
The tenders were conducted through a subsidiary.
Fomamex said it sees the refinancing reducing interest expense in the second half of 1997 by $4.0 million.
The reduction assumes no material changes in interest rates, Foamex said.
It said that based on current market conditions, Foamex's average interest rate on its debt in the immediate future is expected to be about 8-3/4 percent.
The company said future interest expense, and the ability to realize the expected savings in interest expense, will vary based on several factors, including fluctuation in interest rates in general.
Foamex LP also repaid all borrowings under the terms of an existing credit facility which amounted to $5.2 million.

In addition, Foamex LP signed a new $480 million bank facility with 39 lenders, which had received commitments exceeding $1 billion for the facility. The facility includes a $150 million revolver that expires in six years, which can be used to fund working capital needs and future growth.

Foamex said it has also successfully completed a private placement of $150 million principal amount of Foamex LP senior subordinated notes. The notes will pay interest semi-annually at a rate of 9-7/8 percent per annum with a final maturity on June 15, 2007.

The proceeds from the private placement, along with borrowings of about $350 million under the $480 million credit facility, were used to fund the repurchase of the public debt, repay borrowings under the existing credit facility and pay related fees and expenses.

Andrea Farace, Foamex's chairman and chief executive said, "With these steps, we have achieved a milestone in the program initiated 20 months ago to strengthen Foamex's operations and financial flexibility."
